title: A compatible finite flat punctured model with etale quotient
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth], f in its maximal ideal, and U the complement of its closed point [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let q:Y→U be finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. If its actual restriction to the inverse image of U in Spec(A/(f)) [def-pc-fibre-product] has a finite etale extension to Spec(A/(f)), then there is a finite flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] r:F→Spec A with an isomorphism Y≅r⁻¹(U) over U, and the base change of r to Spec(A/(f)) is etale. This statement constructs the model and its quotient, and does not assert that r is etale.

proof.text: Lift the given quotient cover to a finite etale completed model, together with its isomorphism to the completed punctured cover.
Apply finite completion gluing, retaining both the isomorphism over U and the identification of the completed finite model with the lifted cover.

Mathlib AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian and algebraMap_isLocalHom_of_fg show that A→C is flat and local, hence faithfully flat by Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom. The corresponding affine scheme map is flat, surjective and quasi-compact. Transfer etaleness across the completed model isomorphism and descend it with MorphismProperty.of_pullback_snd_of_descendsAlong and Mathlib LocalFlatDescent. Etaleness implies flatness, and base change gives the required etale principal quotient. Retain the gluing isomorphism over U.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_flat_model_of_depth_three_of_quotient_extension (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] (f : A) (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A) (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite q] [Etale q] (hquot : let i := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}))) let V := i ⁻¹ᵁ U ∃ (F₀ : Scheme.{u}) (r₀ : F₀ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}))), IsFinite r₀ ∧ Etale r₀ ∧ ∃ e₀ : pullback q (i ∣_ U) ≅ (r₀ ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme, e₀.hom ≫ r₀ ∣_ V = pullback.snd q (i ∣_ U)) : ∃ (F : Scheme.{u}) (r : F ⟶ Spec (.of A)), IsFinite r ∧ Flat r ∧ Etale (pullback.snd r (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}))))) ∧ ∃ e : Y ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, e.hom ≫ r ∣_ U = q
